canonical_statement: The POLARIX trial compared the efficacy and safety of pola-R-CHP with R-CHOP in previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We conducted the phase 3 POLARIX trial to compare the efficacy and safety of pola-R-CHP versus R-CHOP in patients with previously untreated DLBCL.

canonical_statement: POLARIX was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, international phase 3 study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: POLARIX is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, international phase 3 study.

canonical_statement: The study was sponsored by Genentech, Inc. and F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study was sponsored by Genentech, Inc. and F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

canonical_statement: Third-party medical writing assistance was funded by F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Third-party medical writing assistance ... was funded by F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

canonical_statement: Qualified researchers may request individual patient-level data through the Vivli clinical study data request platform, subject to Roche eligibility criteria.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Qualified researchers may request access to individual patient-level data through the clinical study data request platform (https://vivli.org/).

canonical_statement: Eligible patients were 18-80 years old with previously untreated CD20-positive DLBCL, Ann Arbor stage I-IV, ECOG performance status 0-2, IPI score 2-5, and adequate hematologic, renal, hepatic, and cardiac function.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients aged 18–80 years with CD20-positive DLBCL ... ECOG performance status of 0–2 ... Ann Arbor Stage I–IV ... IPI score of 2–5 ... adequate hematologic, renal, hepatic and cardiac function were eligible for inclusion.

population.label: Eligible POLARIX population
inclusion_criteria: Adequate hematologic, renal, hepatic, and cardiac function

canonical_statement: Study entry required at least one bidimensionally measurable lesion greater than 1.5 cm in its longest dimension.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At least one bi-dimensionally measurable lesion, defined as >1.5 cm in its longest dimension as measured by computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging.

population.label: Eligible POLARIX population
inclusion_criteria: At least one bidimensionally measurable lesion >1.5 cm

canonical_statement: Study entry required left ventricular ejection fraction of at least 50%.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50% on cardiac multiple-gated acquisition scan or cardiac echocardiogram.

canonical_statement: Serum creatinine clearance below 40 mL/min was an exclusion criterion unless the abnormality was attributable to underlying lymphoma as specified by the protocol.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Serum creatinine clearance <40 mL/min

canonical_statement: Current grade greater than 1 peripheral neuropathy or a demyelinating form of Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease was an exclusion criterion.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Current Grade >1 peripheral neuropathy by clinical examination or demyelinating form of Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

canonical_statement: Key exclusions included a history of indolent lymphoma, contraindication to any R-CHOP component, prior anthracycline exposure, and known CNS involvement.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Key exclusion criteria included a history of indolent lymphoma, contraindications to any component of R-CHOP, prior receipt of anthracyclines, and known central nervous system (CNS) involvement.

canonical_statement: Eligible patients were randomized 1:1 to pola-R-CHP or R-CHOP, stratified by IPI score (2 vs 3-5), bulky disease (lesion at least 7.5 cm vs absent), and geographic region; investigator, sponsor, and patients were blinded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Eligible patients were randomized 1:1 to pola-R-CHP or R-CHOP ... stratified according to IPI score ... bulky disease ... geographical region ... The investigator, sponsor, and patients were blinded to treatment assignment.

canonical_statement: The pola-R-CHP arm used six 21-day cycles of polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV on day 1 plus rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV on day 1, and prednisone 100 mg orally once daily on days 1-5; cycles 7-8 were rituximab monotherapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The first six cycles were pola-R-CHP ... intravenous polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg ... rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, and doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 on Day 1, and oral prednisone 100 mg once daily on Days 1–5. Cycles 7–8 comprised rituximab 375 mg/m2 monotherapy in both arms.

exposures.details: Six 21-day cycles: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1; rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1; cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1; doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1; prednisone 100 mg PO days 1-5; cycles 7-8 rituximab monotherapy

canonical_statement: The R-CHOP arm used six 21-day cycles of vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 IV (maximum 2 mg) on day 1 plus rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV on day 1, and prednisone 100 mg orally once daily on days 1-5; cycles 7-8 were rituximab monotherapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: R-CHOP ... vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 (maximum 2 mg) ... rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, and doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 on Day 1, and oral prednisone 100 mg once daily on Days 1–5. Cycles 7–8 comprised rituximab 375 mg/m2 monotherapy in both arms.

exposures.details: Six 21-day cycles: vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 IV (max 2 mg) day 1; rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1; cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1; doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1; prednisone 100 mg PO days 1-5; cycles 7-8 rituximab monotherapy

canonical_statement: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis was required during the first six treatment cycles; intrathecal CNS prophylaxis and preplanned consolidative radiotherapy were permitted under protocol-defined conditions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Central nervous system prophylaxis with intrathecal chemotherapy ... was permitted. Granulocyte-colony stimulating factor administration was required during the first six cycles ... Consolidative radiotherapy ... was permitted at the discretion of the investigator.

canonical_statement: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival was time from randomization to first disease progression, relapse, or death from any cause and was the primary efficacy endpoint.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary efficacy endpoint was investigator-assessed progression-free survival, defined as the time from the date of randomization until the first occurrence of disease progression, relapse, or death from any cause.

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to disease progression, relapse, or death from any cause

canonical_statement: Investigator-assessed event-free survival was time from randomization to the earliest of progression/relapse, death, initiation of non-protocol anti-lymphoma treatment, or biopsy-confirmed residual disease after treatment completion.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: event-free survival (i.e., time from randomization to the earliest occurrence of disease progression/relapse, death due to any cause, initiation of any non-protocol specified anti-lymphoma treatment, or biopsy-confirmed residual disease after treatment completion)

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to progression/relapse, death, non-protocol anti-lymphoma treatment, or biopsy-confirmed residual disease

canonical_statement: Disease-free survival was time from first documented complete response to relapse or death from any cause and was analyzed only among patients who achieved a complete response.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: disease-free survival, defined as the time from the date of first documented CR to the date of relapse or death from any cause. Disease-free survival analyses were conditional on patients achieving response

outcome.definition: Time from first documented complete response to relapse or death from any cause

canonical_statement: Duration of response was time from first documented best response to relapse or death from any cause among patients with complete or partial response.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: DOR was defined as the time from the date of first documented best response to the date of relapse or death from any cause for patients with a best overall response of complete response or partial response.

outcome.definition: Time from first documented best response to relapse or death from any cause among CR/PR responders

canonical_statement: Efficacy analyses used the intention-to-treat population of all randomized patients; safety analyses included patients who received at least one study drug, with pola-R-CHP safety requiring polatuzumab exposure.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Efficacy analyses were conducted using the intention-to-treat (ITT) population, defined as all randomized patients; the safety analysis population included all patients who received at least one dose of any study drug, and specifically for the pola-R-CHP arm, any exposure to polatuzumab vedotin treatment.

canonical_statement: The primary analysis was planned after 228 progression events; 875 planned patients and 228 events provided 80% power at one-sided alpha 0.025 to detect a minimum hazard ratio of 0.77 for PFS, assuming HR 0.69.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: assuming a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.69, 875 planned patients and 228 progression events were required to provide the trial with 80% power at a one-sided 2.5% ... significance level to detect ... HR 0.77

canonical_statement: A hierarchical testing procedure with possible alpha recycling controlled the overall one-sided type I error at 0.025 across the primary PFS endpoint and key secondary EFS, end-of-treatment CR, and overall-survival endpoints.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To control the overall type I error rate at a one-sided 0.025 level of significance, a hierarchical testing procedure including possible α recycling was used ... key secondary endpoints ... event-free survival [EFS], CR rate ... and overall survival were hierarchically tested
